additions.note: Frontier model for long-horizon engineering, coding and cybersecurity. Google is initially rolling it out to selected cyber defenders and trusted Fairwind partners; broader product and developer access is forthcoming.
Enterprise speech-to-speech model for voice agents, with inspectable text and tool calls alongside spoken responses.
Interactive world simulation model with real-time text steering and native audio. Research preview for trusted testers; Project Genie and developer access are planned.
Compact shared-backbone family covering text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks; six specialized models build on a 1.7B base. The LFM Open License imposes commercial conditions.
Image-editing model preview available on Arena, Artificial Analysis and MAI Playground. Text-to-image generation is planned separately.
Swiss-developed reasoning models for cloud and on-premises deployment. Alto is available in free chat; Solo targets single-GPU deployment.
Open-weight document parsing model for long multi-page documents. Weights were uploaded October 26 UTC; the model card dates its release October 27.
Apache-2.0 30B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters for simultaneous translation.

sourceSweep.lab: Google / Rime / Liquid AI / Microsoft / Giotto / Baidu / Tencent
